# bugs #3674: --std-sdccXX: explicit cast on a variable argument is ignored unless its operand is a variable

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3674/
- Category: [Fixes that need a decision](../../fix-decision.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Run bug-3674 and bug-3172 on ds390, mos6502, and pic, which were not built. Then apply and close with #3172.
- Patch: [bugs-3674.patch](../../patches/bugs-3674.patch), commit [`046244906`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/0462449066c91c3f6cc9a3ce72556a0f7e30a296). Applies to r17176 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

With `--std-sdccXX`, sdcc passes variable arguments that have an explicit cast without integer
promotion. Since SDCC 4.5.15 it does so only for mcs51, ds390, mos6502, mos65c02, pic14, and pic16.
For the other ports, among them sm83 and z80 from the ticket, `processParms` in trunk promotes
these arguments in every case, so the mixture of sizes in the ticket cannot occur there.

On mcs51 the error is present in all memory models. `(uint8_t)var` passes one byte, and
`(uint8_t)f ()`, `(uint8_t)*p`, `(uint8_t)a[i]`, and `(uint8_t)ps->m` each pass an `int`. In the
callee, `va_arg (ap, unsigned char)` then reads the wrong bytes.

## Cause

`decorateType` in `src/SDCCast.c` removes casts to the type that the operand already has, and it
sets `removedCast` in the node of the operand. `processParms` tests `removedCast` only on nodes
that are symbols. For every other operand the tree has no cast node and the flag is not read, so
`processParms` adds the promotion to `int`. A cast that changes the type stays in the tree as a
`CAST` node, which is why the double cast in the ticket works.

## Fix

`processParms` tests `removedCast` on every argument node. The flag is a bit in the `values` union
of the `ast` node. The other members of the union belong to block, `switch`, `for`,
inline-assembler, array-initializer, and function nodes, and to argument nodes after iCode
generation has started.

## Decision

The patch changes the behavior of programs that relied on the promotion.
`printf ("%d", (unsigned char)a[i])` passes one byte with the patch, as the manual documents for
`--std-sdccXX`. The alternative is to keep the promotion for operands that are not variables and
to document that limit.

The change takes effect on ds390, mos6502, mos65c02, pic14, and pic16, which were not built. Run
`bug-3674` and `bug-3172` on those ports before applying the patch.

## Verification

`support/regression/tests/bug-3674.c` passes arguments of each form above to a variadic function.
The function reads them with `va_arg` as `unsigned char` on the six ports and as `int` on the
others. The patch also enables the assertions in `bug-3172.c.in`. Without the change to `SDCCast.c`
both tests fail on mcs51. With it they pass on the host, the six mcs51 variants, stm8, and ucz80.
For mcs51, the patch changes no assembly of the other regression tests or of the libraries.

The two tests assert `unsigned char` for ds390, mos6502, mos65c02, pic14, and pic16.

## Related

Bug #3172 has the same cause and is fixed by this patch.
